title: The agentic Research Studio: typed agents propose, a deterministic worker measures
request: Turn the fixed campaign into an adaptive learning loop: agents interpret a research goal, audit the data, choose a bounded experiment, critique the measured result and pick the next test, without ever owning the numbers. Add HyperAck and churn as first-class projects and a field guide of what was learned.
spec: A LangGraph loop with typed NOOA specialists and the OpenAI Responses API; a validated experiment language instead of generated code; an isolated worker that owns data access, preprocessing, training and metrics; budgets of 1 to 50 experiments, pause and resume, run history and trajectory export; three evidence contexts (open tabular lab, HyperAck, Telco churn); a field guide with 22 rules and 10 workflow blocks; archives and clean exports of every run.
plan: Build the loop: LangGraph owns the durable state; NOOA specialists plan, review the data, design the experiment, critique the result and curate lessons.
Make agents return an experiment in a validated schema; the worker refuses blocked columns and their descendants and fits preprocessing inside each training fold.

Keep exact duplicate input rows in one fold, propagate source-column masking through derived features, and record fingerprints, repeat-level metrics, out-of-fold predictions, calibration and missing-input stress.
Add HyperAck and Telco churn as separate projects, with new HyperAck runs blocking the final fares.
Write the model-building field guide, the 22 rules and the 10 workflow blocks from the evidence, with an optional four-reviewer LLM pass.
Archive every run's output and write clean cards and an SFT export beside the raw artefacts.

decisions.decision: Generated Python is never executed; agents return a validated experiment language.
decisions.why: Only an isolated deterministic worker may touch data and compute metrics, so an agent cannot leak, skip a fold or invent a number.

decisions.decision: Raw dataset rows and API keys are never sent to the model, and provider storage is off.
decisions.why: The agents need summaries and evidence ids, not data; the owner's data must not leave the machine.

decisions.decision: Every trajectory is marked training_ready false.
decisions.why: A person must verify claims, licences, privacy and source-grouped train and evaluation separation before a trajectory trains a model.

decisions.decision: When the reviewer model could not run, merge nothing into the field guide.
decisions.why: The four-reviewer pass was blocked by exhausted API credit; the status file records the failure instead of invented findings.

change: dclab_rnd/agentic/ (agents, engine, worker, schemas, catalog, projects, server and UI, archive, clean_export, guide_review), dclab_rnd/master_review.py, the field guide, master evidence pack, 22 rules and 10 workflow blocks under knowledge/, and worker safety tests.
outcome: A working, local research loop where models propose and critique and code measures; its safety rules (blocked ancestors, fold-only fitting, no executed code) are covered by worker tests. Its decision quality was not measured here; the 26 September pilot (RD-real-evaluation-pilot) found 3 of 6 archived cycles completed and could not score the planner because the provider failed.
lessons: An agent's proposal should be data in a schema, never code: the schema is what a validator and a worker can enforce.
When the model call fails, record the failure; a guide padded with invented reviews poisons everything trained on it.
